notes: GPT-5.6 Luna rates were refreshed from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna on 2026-08-16.
Native Batch rates apply the documented 50 percent Batch API discount.
Requests above 272000 input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full request.
Cache writes are billed at 1.25x the corresponding uncached input rate.

The model page does not explicitly state how the Batch discount composes with the long-context multipliers. The authorization ceiling conservatively does not assume a Batch discount for requests whose byte upper bound crosses the tier; receipt accounting applies the documented multipliers to native-Batch usage.
